title: A belated birthday
setting: The morning after a rainy night, Satou-san, the elderly neighbour, leaves a voicemail for Kenta. Kenta walked him home from the station last night, and only once he got home did Satou-san work out whose birthday it was.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: moshimoshi, satou desu. kinou no yoru wa, ame no naka, uchi made okutte kurete, arigatou gozaimashita.
lines.ja: もしもし、佐藤です。きのうの夜は、雨の中、うちまで送ってくれて、ありがとうございました。
lines.kana: もしもし、さとうです。きのうのよるは、あめのなか、うちまでおくってくれて、ありがとうございました。
lines.english: Hello, it's Satou. Thank you for seeing me home in the rain last night.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: hisashiburi ni mukashi no tomodachi ni atte, osoku natte shimatte.
lines.ja: 久しぶりに昔の友達に会って、遅くなってしまって。
lines.kana: ひさしぶりにむかしのともだちにあって、おそくなってしまって。
lines.english: I'd been out seeing an old friend for the first time in ages, and it got late.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: eki de kenta-san ga, ie made okurimasu yo tte, kasa o sashite kurete.
lines.ja: 駅でケンタさんが、「家まで送りますよ」って、傘をさしてくれて。
lines.kana: えきでけんたさんが、「いえまでおくりますよ」って、かさをさしてくれて。
lines.english: Then at the station you said, "I'll see you home," and held your umbrella over me.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: demo kenta-san mo, kore kara tomodachi ni au tokoro datta n desu ne.
lines.ja: でもケンタさんも、これから友達に会うところだったんですね。
lines.kana: でもけんたさんも、これからともだちにあうところだったんですね。
lines.english: But you were on your way to meet your friends too, weren't you?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: kenta-san no sumaho kara, tanjoubi omedetou tte, minna no koe ga kikoemashita.
lines.ja: ケンタさんのスマホから、「誕生日おめでとう」って、みんなの声が聞こえました。
lines.kana: けんたさんのすまほから、「たんじょうびおめでとう」って、みんなのこえがきこえました。
lines.english: I could hear everyone on your phone saying "Happy birthday."

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: uchi ni kaette kara, yatto wakarimashita. kinou wa kenta-san no tanjoubi datta n desu ne.
lines.ja: うちに帰ってから、やっとわかりました。きのうは、ケンタさんの誕生日だったんですね。
lines.kana: うちにかえってから、やっとわかりました。きのうは、けんたさんのたんじょうびだったんですね。
lines.english: It only clicked once I got home. Yesterday was your birthday, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: minna de tanjoubi o iwau yotei datta n deshou?
lines.ja: みんなで誕生日を祝う予定だったんでしょう？
lines.kana: みんなでたんじょうびをいわうよていだったんでしょう？
lines.english: You were all going to celebrate it together, weren't you?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sore na noni, watashi o uchi made okutte kurete. hontou ni sumimasen deshita.
lines.ja: それなのに、わたしをうちまで送ってくれて。本当にすみませんでした。
lines.kana: それなのに、わたしをうちまでおくってくれて。ほんとうにすみませんでした。
lines.english: And still you walked me all the way home. I'm truly sorry.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: kondo no shuumatsu wa, jikka ni kaeru tte itte imashita ne.
lines.ja: 今度の週末は、実家に帰るって言っていましたね。
lines.kana: こんどのしゅうまつは、じっかにかえるっていっていましたね。
lines.english: You said you're going back to your parents' this weekend, didn't you?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: jikka ni kaeru mae ni, ichido uchi ni kite kuremasen ka?
lines.ja: 実家に帰る前に、一度うちに来てくれませんか？
lines.kana: じっかにかえるまえに、いちどうちにきてくれませんか？
lines.english: Before you head off to your parents', would you come round to my place?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sukoshi osoku narimashita ga, watashi ni mo tanjoubi o iwawasete kudasai.
lines.ja: 少し遅くなりましたが、わたしにも誕生日を祝わせてください。
lines.kana: すこしおそくなりましたが、わたしにもたんじょうびをいわわせてください。
lines.english: It's a little late, but please let me celebrate your birthday too.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: mukashi no tomodachi ni au no mo ii desu ga, atarashii tomodachi to nomu osake mo, ii mono desu kara ne.
lines.ja: 昔の友達に会うのもいいですが、新しい友達と飲むお酒も、いいものですからね。
lines.kana: むかしのともだちにあうのもいいですが、あたらしいともだちとのむおさけも、いいものですからね。
lines.english: Seeing old friends is lovely, but a drink with a new friend is lovely too, you know.

questions.ja: 佐藤さんは、何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんは、なんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san wa, nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Satou-san walked Kenta home in the rain, and now asks to come along to Kenta's parents' place this weekend.
Satou-san missed his own birthday because he was out with an old friend, so he invites Kenta over to celebrate it.
Kenta walked Satou-san home on Kenta's own birthday, so Satou-san invites him round to celebrate before Kenta goes to his parents'.

questions.explanation: Lines 1 and 3: Kenta saw Satou-san home from the station in the rain (uchi made okutte kurete; ie made okurimasu yo). Lines 5-7: Satou-san heard 'happy birthday' on Kenta's phone and, once home, realised it had been Kenta's birthday and his friends had a plan to celebrate. Lines 10-11: he asks Kenta round before he goes to his parents' and asks to celebrate his birthday too. A swaps the roles: Kenta did the walking, and Satou-san asks Kenta to come to his place, not to go along to Kenta's parents'. B: the birthday was Kenta's. Satou-san's evening with his old friend (line 2) just ran late.

questions.english: Kenta asks: "Are you free on Saturday? Want to go to a movie?" You're meeting up with a friend that day. Tell him.
questions.ja: 土曜日、ひま？映画に行かない？
questions.kana: どようび、ひま？えいがにいかない？
questions.answer: Say you're seeing a friend with tomodachi ni au, using ni, not o: gomen, doyoubi wa tomodachi ni au n da.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, doyoubi wa tomodachi ni au n da.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、土曜日は友達に会うんだ。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I'm seeing a friend on Saturday.

modelAnswers.romaji: a, doyoubi wa hisashiburi ni tomodachi ni au yotei na n da. nichiyoubi wa dou?
modelAnswers.ja: あ、土曜日は久しぶりに友達に会う予定なんだ。日曜日はどう？
modelAnswers.english: Oh, on Saturday I'm meeting a friend I haven't seen in ages. How about Sunday?

questions.explanation: The person you meet takes ni: Satou-san says mukashi no tomodachi ni atte (line 2) and kore kara tomodachi ni au tokoro (line 4). English 'meet a friend' pulls toward tomodachi o au, which is wrong, and tomodachi o miru would mean watching your friend, not meeting up. tomodachi to au also works and suggests a meet-up you both arranged.

questions.english: According to Satou-san, what did Kenta say to him at the station?
questions.ja: 駅で、ケンタさんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: えきで、けんたさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: eki de, kenta-san wa nan to iimashita ka?
questions.explanation: Line 3: eki de kenta-san ga, ie made okurimasu yo tte. Satou-san says it back in lines 1 and 8 as uchi made okutte kurete, uchi being his own home. A, tsurete ikimasu, is English 'take you home' word for word, but tsurete iku is leading someone who can't go alone, like a child or a drunk friend. Said to Satou-san, it would treat him as helpless. Seeing someone home as a courtesy is okuru. C is English 'see you home' word for word, but miru only means look or watch, so it says nothing about walking him home.

questions.english: Mai asks what you're doing this weekend. You're going back to your parents' place. Tell her.
questions.kana: こんどのしゅうまつ、なにするの？
questions.romaji: kondo no shuumatsu, nani suru no?
questions.answer: Say you're going back to your parents' with jikka ni kaeru: jikka ni kaeru n da.

modelAnswers.english: I'm going home to my parents'.

modelAnswers.romaji: hisashiburi ni jikka ni kaeru yo. kotoshi hajimete.
modelAnswers.ja: 久しぶりに実家に帰るよ。今年初めて。
modelAnswers.english: I'm going back to my parents' for the first time in a while. First time this year.

questions.explanation: Satou-san says kondo no shuumatsu wa, jikka ni kaeru tte (line 9) and jikka ni kaeru mae ni (line 10). jikka is the home you grew up in, and you kaeru to it because it's a return, even after years away. Plain uchi ni kaeru, as in line 6 when Satou-san gets back to his own place, only means going home. English 'go to my parents' place' leads to oya no uchi ni iku, which sounds like a visit to someone else's house.

questions.english: Near the end, what does Satou-san ask to do?
questions.ja: 佐藤さんは、何がしたいと言いましたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんは、なにがしたいといいましたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san wa, nani ga shitai to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Celebrate Kenta's birthday with him at Satou-san's place, a little late.
Go with Kenta to his parents' and celebrate his birthday there.
Have Kenta and his friends round to celebrate the old friend's birthday.

questions.explanation: Line 11: watashi ni mo tanjoubi o iwawasete kudasai, 'please let me celebrate your birthday too'. iwau is celebrate, and -sasete kudasai asks to be allowed to. sukoshi osoku narimashita ga ('it's a little late') because the birthday was yesterday (line 6). The place is his own home: ichido uchi ni kite kuremasen ka (line 10). B: Kenta goes to his parents' on his own; Satou-san wants to see him before that (jikka ni kaeru mae ni). C: the plan in line 7 (minna de tanjoubi o iwau yotei) was Kenta's friends celebrating Kenta, and nobody mentions a birthday for Satou-san's old friend.

newWords.english: once, one time (ichido kite = come over sometime)
